Stand Alone Pop Up

Nutrafol

The Future of Clear Skin

Pop Up Mob placed Nutrafol Skin at the center of Chelsea Triangle, turning one of NYC's busiest corners into a skincare meeting point that introduced the brand's supplement-backed approach to skin, creating a space where people could understand the inside-out philosophy firsthand and experience the expansion into skin beyond the shelf.

BeautyJune 2025NYC, New York100% Experiential
The Story
NYC, New York

The space expanded that message through thoughtful details, a larger-than-life capsule that made the supplement story visible from blocks away, quiet educational moments that broke down the science in an approachable way, refreshing juices that nodded to wellness from within, and simple gifting that encouraged guests to continue the journey at Sephora. Set in the middle of Chelsea's constant movement, it created a grounded, trustworthy pause point, inviting people to slow down, learn, and see skin health as something built over time, not just applied on the surface.
